Distance-weight specification (S3)

Source: R/wdist.R
new_dist_weight.Rd

A distance-weight takes a numeric distance vector dx (length n) or a distance matrix DX (n x m) and returns weights w (length n) or a weight matrix (n x m). Provide either a compiled ptr (fast path), an R eval_dx for single-target evaluation, or an R eval_dx_batch for many targets.

Usage

new_dist_weight(
  name,
  setup = NULL,
  eval_dx = NULL,
  eval_dx_batch = NULL,
  ptr = NULL,
  randomized = FALSE
)

Arguments

name

Character scalar.

setup

Optional function(data, ...) -> ctx object (list or externalptr), used to precompute bandwidths, scaling, etc., from training data.

eval_dx

R fallback: function(dx, ctx) -> numeric(n).

eval_dx_batch

R fast path: function(DX, ctx) -> matrix(n, m).

ptr

External pointer to compiled implementation (optional).

randomized

Logical: does the weighting rule use randomness?

Value

An object of class dist_weight.
